provider: lz.qaiu.top, the keyless multi-pan direct-link resolver

free_tier.stated: free public resolver, no allowance stated: https://github.com/qaiu/netdisk-fast-download/blob/main/README.md lists lz.qaiu.top as a 公益 (free public) instance and prints no quota, unit or price for it

retention.stated: Not applicable. The instance caches a resolved ecpan link for 5 minutes, and the signed redirect carries X-Amz-Expires=86400, so a URL is resolved per session rather than stored

egress.terms: Free. It issues a 302 to the real CDN origin, so the bytes never traverse the resolver: verified against China Mobile EOS with X-Amz-Expires=86400

tooling: two public keyless forms, GET https://lz.qaiu.top/parser?url=<enc>&pwd=<pin> which 302s, or the short form https://lz.qaiu.top/ec/<key>@<pin>. A mirror at lz0.qaiu.top. Self-hostable from the repository with Docker on ports 6400 and 6401
chaining: Pair with a public AList that lists share links, or with any resource site, to fetch Chinese-pan content without an account. The server software can also be installed and run on a rented or free machine, the last resort after the hosted instances

limits.value: it resolves and does not store: there is no write path at all

no per-client limit is published for the public instance; the owner announces that from August 2026 requests with no Referer header may be rate limited, with no figure; 100 parallel requests with no Referer from one address were all answered 200

identity_cost.detail: no account, no key and no cookie for the free drivers. The professional endpoint needs an X-API-Key

reliability_note: Alive and actively maintained, Trendshift-listed. It is the project's official free public instance. The README asks users not to over-rely on it. The README says heavy request volume can get the server limited by the pan vendors.

binding_note: The resolver is free, keyless and fast, and it stores nothing, so what binds is that it only resolves: there is no write path, and the pans a client would most want are behind the keyed endpoint.
notes: The single highest-leverage piece of glue in the topic and the reason the pan survey is usable at all. Two endpoints, and the split is the finding: the free one covers lanzou, ilanzou, ctfile, wenshushu, feijipan and ecpan, and the keyed one adds Baidu, Xunlei, Quark, UC, 139, 189 and Unicom.
